hint.claudeAccount: The email their Claude Code account uses. It is how work done in Claude is tied back to a person here.
hint.diagnostics: Whether the four commands the panel drives are reachable: git and python3 are required, wizrelay runs the gates, and claude runs the conversational ones. Below them, whatever wizrelay doctor reports about the first connected repository.
hint.hubCopy: The panel keeps its own shallow clone of the hub so it can read the packages. It never writes to a working copy you mounted yourself.
hint.hubRole: The part this repository plays in the hub — backend, web, and so on. The list comes from the hub's own wizrelay-hub.json, and a repository already set up by wizrelay overrides the choice with the role in its .wizrelay/config.json.
hint.medianWait: How long a gate prompt sits unanswered, halfway down the list. The number that says whether people are waiting on the pipeline or the pipeline is waiting on people.
hint.needsYou: Gates that stopped and asked a human a question. Nothing moves on these until somebody answers.
hint.packageStatus: Derived from the files the gates wrote — the hub package and each repository's .wizrelay folder. The panel stores no status of its own.
hint.panelRole: What someone may do across the whole panel. Owner and admin manage hubs and people; a member only reaches the projects they are given.
hint.policySource: Where the policy came from: the plugin ships a default, and a hub overrides it with policies/routing-policy.json. A hub that has none uses the default.
hint.projectRoles: What someone may do inside one project. Researcher runs the research gates, developer runs the delivery gates, and one person can be both.
hint.researchLead: Who an unanswered research question goes to for this project. It defaults to the owner.
hint.routingPolicy: How much ceremony a task gets. wizrelay scores each one — size, risk, how much of the codebase it touches — and the tier that score falls into decides which phases run and how strictly. The panel only shows it; the policy itself is edited in the hub, so the whole team shares one.
hint.scopeViolations: Files a change touched that its package did not put in scope. The package lists the paths each role may edit; anything outside counts here.
hint.verdicts: The verify gate result for each delivery track, counted as passed / partial / failed. It comes from the verification.md the gate wrote, not from the panel.
hint.version: The package version in the hub. An arrow means the hub is ahead of what the repositories have pulled.
hub.branchHelp: The branch packages are read from. Change it and the panel's clone re-syncs on the next read.
hub.branchUnread: The remote could not be read just now, so its branches are not listed. You can type one.
